research.title: Retained chronological market-path study: 33 completed local fits, reused unchanged
research.summary: 33 retained predictive model fits across 11 fixed alternatives, plus 11 separately counted training-only standardizers. The retained V035 local preparation reused their states and predictions without refitting; the actual V035 owner stopped before research admission. The path cohort has 257 training and 312 test games; the separate availability/path cohort has 115 training and 125 test games. These are exposed-2025 local development experiments, with no current-season model selection or promotion.
research.evaluation_status: Completed local exposed-2025 development; no new SageMaker execution, genuine forecast, or order.
limitations: Retained local V035 preparation added current source and feature evidence. It makes zero new fits and preserves all 33 prior predictive fits plus 11 separately counted standardizers; no SageMaker execution is inferred from this local work.

Compare variants within each cohort: the path study uses 257 training / 312 test games, while the availability/path study uses 115 training / 125 test games. Both use a fixed November 1, 2025 boundary on a previously exposed season. No season-2026 outcomes were consumed.

The fixed inventory contains 3,683 historical requests: 3,682 successful responses from 3,743 HTTP calls, with all 61 rate-limit failures and one unresolved request preserved. DraftKings historical in-game paths were unavailable through an authorized adapter. Fixed-strike probability paths are not point-spread or total trajectories.

Of 904 game-state responses, 324 pass the broad explicit-boundary identity gate, 46 have monotone play clocks, and 31 also have complete wallclock coverage. The broader fitted study remains timing uncertified; historical source possession, continuous-duration coverage and executable liquidity are not proved.

A separate official MAC extension adds 32 PDFs, 1,597 listed-player rows and 171 team-report pages. Exactly 161 pages match 112 canonical games; ten remain unresolved. No position fields or certified historical publication clocks were supplied. These rows did not expand the frozen fitted cohorts.

The earlier injury association study is preserved without refitting. No player contribution, replacement quality, causal injury effect, promotion or qualified betting edge is established. NO BET; zero stake.

research_checkpoint.fit_count_definition: Predictive estimators are counted separately from training-only normalization; no recalibration fits or original-study repeats.
scientific_limitations: The 2025 season was already exposed; these are development results, not a protected prospective test.
Source acquisition uses a truncated scheduled window; full-game trajectories and true continuous dominance are not measured.

Fixed-threshold margin/total probability paths are not reconstructed point spreads or fair totals.
One exchange total-market request exhausted its429 retries; venue gaps and missing clock/state fields remain explicit.
MAC extension rows were retained separately and did not alter either existing injury study or the fixed V034 cohort.
